decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already updates the About page prize-draw copy to the new Small and Big Block quantities and sales thresholds.
A same-message MODIFY already changes the Small Block winner count, pool amount per draw, and draw condition to 1 × $500 every 100 sales.
A same-message MODIFY already changes the Big Block winner count, prize-pool total, and sales-count trigger to 1 × $10,000 every 10,000 sales.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just thought of something.... I believe we should adjust the block prizes to
- Small = 1 x $500 every 100 sales.
- Big = 1 x $10,000 every 10,000 sales.

The same net $ amount would still be given away, but this would create a smoother, cleaner, clearer, and more consistent flow of winners

decisions.reason: Changing prize quantities and draw cadence does not change the current or conditional future project names.
The revised draws preserve the same aggregate prize amount per sale, so the existing $6 primary-sale prize-pool allocation remains unchanged.
Prize quantities and draw frequency do not alter how the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired tickets behave when an NFT transfers.
The source changes prize draw parameters but does not change the flat secondary royalty, founder allocation, pool-funding treatment, or ticket-generation rule for secondary sales.
The source changes prize amounts and cadence but does not resolve or alter the separate ambiguity between automatic delivery and one-click claiming.
Changing prize draw parameters does not alter fiat-user dashboard access or the wallet requirements for receiving commissions and holding prize tickets.
Message 158 does not itself remove or modify Aave yield generation; any later statement about Aave is outside the source-event cutoff and requires its own Event.
The revised Small and Big Block prize parameters do not change badge triggers, thresholds, destination, or current function.
